summary: A monthly plan whose fee comes back as usage, then per-second measured CPU with a 100-millicore floor, reserved memory, and stored disk in decimal GB.

egress.note: No free outbound traffic. Every GB a machine sends out is billed; inbound is free. Not priced by the calculator.

plans.name: Pro
plans.note: The $25 fee returns as $25 of usage. A 7-day Pro trial includes $5 of usage; a card is asked at the first sandbox.

notes: A paused machine pays only for storage, at the warm rate; a deleted machine costs nothing.
CPU is billed on use with a 0.1 vCPU floor while running. Memory is billed on what the machine holds, while it runs.
Running disk is $0.10 per decimal GB per 30-day month (standard); paused storage is $0.18 per GB-month (warm). The hourly rates divide by 720 hours.
Usage past the plan's included amount is charged as it adds up, at $50, $100, $250, $500, then every $1,000.
There is no free plan. Cancelling, or an unpaid charge, pauses machines; their data is deleted 30 days later.

upkeep.label: What you keep up
upkeep.detail: When Runtime updates its default image, a paused sandbox or snapshot keeps its old files; only new sandboxes get the update. You run apt yourself.

source.quote: An existing paused sandbox or snapshot keeps the filesystem saved with its memory. Updating Runtime's default image does not replace those files.
